name: translate-book
title_zh: 把整本书拆给多个子代理并行翻译成任何语言
tagline_zh: PDF/DOCX/EPUB 丢进去，自动转 Markdown、分块、并行翻译，再拼回原格式。适合啃外文书但不想等串。
tagline_en: Drop in PDF/DOCX/EPUB, it splits into Markdown chunks, translates in parallel, and rebuilds the original format.
desc_en: Translate books (PDF/DOCX/EPUB) into any language using parallel sub-agents. Converts input -> Markdown chunks -> translated chunks -> HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF.
why_zh: 不是单线程硬翻，而是拆块后多个子代理同时开工，速度随块数近似线性提升；且保留原书结构，不是流水账文本。
why_en: Not a single-thread slog—chunks go to parallel sub-agents, speed scales with chunk count; preserves book structure, not just a.
limit_zh: 只认 PDF/DOCX/EPUB 三种输入；扫描版 PDF 无 OCR，图片型页面会变成空块；输出 HTML/DOCX。
limit_en: Only PDF/DOCX/EPUB in; scanned PDFs lack OCR, image pages become empty chunks; outputs HTML/DOCX/EPUB/PDF but complex layouts (tables, footnotes).
